model_notes.ff_ann: One-hidden-layer feed-forward network trained with backpropagation; 100-unit default, grouped tuning on training rounds only.
model_notes.multinomial_nb: Multinomial naïve Bayes; histogram counts match its count-vector interpretation. On ACK/CLRT summary values it is a nonnegative-feature adaptation, not Formby's original histogram input.

feature_notes.ack_clrt: Existing primary ACK and CLRT inputs; pooled mean, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum for pools greater than one.
feature_notes.formby_histogram: 200 CLRT bins, with 199 equal-width in-range bins and one >H overflow bin; H is fitted on training data only.

caveats: Operation-class labels and the measured relay workload differ from Formby et al.'s device-type fingerprinting labels.
The static/adaptive split is grouped by acquisition round; it is not Formby's random 75/25 split.
late diagnostic contains only windows for which every constituent response exceeded its selected release point by more than 1 ms; small subsets are descriptive only.
Static fully-late diagnostics use the frozen native-trained FF-ANN and only held-out individual responses whose observed total time exceeded the selected response target by >1 ms.

metric_notes.round_accuracy: Accuracy is computed separately for each held-out acquisition round; round mean and minimum summarize those scores.
metric_notes.round_precision: Precision is computed for every class in each held-out round. Mean precision averages class-round precision values; minimum precision is the lowest observed class-round precision. Per-class round means and minima are retained.
metric_notes.round_recall: Recall is computed for every class in each held-out round. Mean recall averages all class-round recalls; minimum recall is the lowest class-round recall. Per-class round means and minima are also retained.
metric_notes.uncertainty: Round minima are observed worst cases, not confidence bounds. Existing balanced-accuracy bootstrap intervals remain separate.
